Learning rate schedules

Source: R/example_optimizers.R
optimizers_schedules.Rd

Ports of the step size schedules of jax.example_libraries.optimizers. A schedule is a function of the (0-based) iteration index returning the step size. optimizers_make_schedule returns a schedule unchanged and turns a scalar into a constant schedule.

Usage

optimizers_constant(step_size)

optimizers_exponential_decay(step_size, decay_steps, decay_rate)

optimizers_inverse_time_decay(
  step_size,
  decay_steps,
  decay_rate,
  staircase = FALSE
)

optimizers_polynomial_decay(step_size, decay_steps, final_step_size, power = 1)

optimizers_piecewise_constant(boundaries, values)

optimizers_make_schedule(scalar_or_schedule)

Arguments

step_size

Initial (or constant) step size.

decay_steps, decay_rate

Decay parameters: the step size is multiplied by decay_rate every decay_steps iterations (exponential_decay) or divided by 1 + decay_rate * i / decay_steps (inverse_time_decay).

staircase

Decay in discrete steps (floor(i / decay_steps)).

final_step_size, power

Final value and power of polynomial_decay.

boundaries, values

Boundaries (one shorter than values) and step sizes of piecewise_constant.

scalar_or_schedule

A scalar or a schedule.

Value

A schedule function.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
s <- optimizers_piecewise_constant(c(10, 20), c(1, 0.1, 0.01))
s(15L)
} # }
